answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity trades freely once its graph spreads like a meadow, not a closed ring. It must anchor to 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs, capped at 15 percent to any one partner; yarrow clusters of mutual-only trades are flagged as sybil rings. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 counterparties at 40 POA each, about 48,000 POA, while each fake earns under 30 POA. An honest agent pays one bond and stays undiluted.
